## Academic Paper Search & DOI Lookup: Crossref Citations
Search Crossref scholarly works or look up DOIs: authors, journal, citations.

Store page: https://apify.com/publicrecords/crossref-papers-doi-lookup
MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=publicrecords/crossref-papers-doi-lookup

Edit the JSON body to change the input, then connect the output to Google Sheets, Slack, Airtable or email.
